resources.note: Bonus Action · jump 10 ft, no opportunity attacks · returns on a long rest

short_rest.msg:
Spend Hit Dice (d8 + CON +3) to recover HP.
Rabbit Hop does NOT return on a short rest.

rest: Long Rest: Full HP, both spell slots, half Hit Dice restored (1 of 1)
Rabbit Hop uses reset on a long rest
Prepared spells can be swapped after a long rest

bonus: Nick (off-hand dagger, part of the Attack action)
reaction: Lucky Footwork — failed DEX save, add a d4
magic: Faerie Fire — advantage for everyone
Ray of Sickness — 2d8 poison
Tinker's Magic — conjure a small mundane item

reminders: Hare-Trigger is already baked into the Initiative +5 pill — proficiency is added to every initiative roll.
Savage Attacker: once per turn, roll your weapon's damage dice twice and keep the better result.
Lucky Footwork is a Reaction on a failed DEX save — add a d4 and it may turn into a success.
Rabbit Hop: 2 per long rest, Bonus Action, 10 ft with no opportunity attacks. Good for disengaging.
You are Small — Heavy weapons give you disadvantage.
All four tool kits sit at +6. Smith's, Tinker's and Poisoner's are your best non-magic answers to a problem.
